references.text: Moses recounts the spies' report about the great, fortified cities and the Anakim, which is the same account as in Numbers 13:28.
Refers to the great and fortified cities as well as the descendants of the Anakim, which the spies reported on.
Mentions the descendants of Anak in Hebron, whom the spies saw during their exploration of the land.
Elaborates on the description of the Anakim as giants (Nephilim), which created fear among the spies.
Joshua drove out the Anakim from the hill country, including the fortified cities that the spies had feared.
Caleb asks to receive the land of the Anakim with its great, fortified cities, which he had seen as a spy.
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from Hebron, who were among those the spies had seen.
Describes the Emim as a great and numerous people, regarded as giants like the Anakim.
